entry: flat; prior close above trend MA; prior oscillator non-positive and rising; volume > 0 -> BUY
exit: long for a full bar; prior oscillator falling; current low crosses prior N-bar low; volume > 0 -> SELL
entry_price_source: No price is stored; source documentation assumes Open and the string signal carries no price.
exit_price_source: _prev_exitl is a trigger threshold, not a fill. Min(Open, ExitL[1]) is documented but not emitted.
execution_assumptions: BUY immediately sets internal position to 1
SELL immediately sets internal position to 0
